title: SG-5.5.2 Update BootScene tests for sceneSpec mock and constructor arity
summary: BootScene test suites mock runtime content with sceneSpec and pass
description: Context: game/frontend/tests/bootSceneEffects.test.ts, bootSceneBuild.test.ts and bootScene.test.ts import the real '../src/runtime/content', which parses the bedroom YAML through the content schema, so the suites do not load. BootScene.ts imports sceneSpec from that module and its constructor takes no arguments. Desired behavior: each suite mocks '../src/runtime/content' with a sceneSpec and passes. Expected result: the three suites pass. Why: the thin-wrapper BootScene must be provable with mocked dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: Given bootSceneEffects.test.ts, when it runs, then it mocks '../src/runtime/content' with a sceneSpec holding objects, layers and effects and its 3 BootScene tests pass
Given bootSceneBuild.test.ts, when it runs, then buildScene is asserted to be called with the mocked sceneSpec and the suite passes
Given bootScene.test.ts, when it runs, then it mocks the content module with a sceneSpec and passes with a zero-argument BootScene constructor
technical_constraints: Vitest with vi.mock; no real Phaser or browser
definition_of_done: The three suites pass with the content module mocked
